prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original, professional symbol-only logo for an independent open-source multiroom music-following smart-home project. Concept: music moves with a person between rooms. Design an original compact flowing ribbon/path joining two offset rounded room-like forms, with a small distinct sound pulse integrated into the path. Cohesive memorable silhouette, warm friendly precision, refined flat vector-like geometry, generous negative space, medium-bold forms that remain readable at 32px. Palette: deep teal #087F83 and a restrained lighter turquoise accent, matching a modern home automation dashboard. Square centered composition, symbol occupies about 75 percent of canvas. Actual transparent background. No lettering, no wordmark, no brand names, no product devices, no house-roof logo, no familiar wifi symbol, no arrows-in-circle, no imitation of any existing brand identity, especially no Sonos, Home Assistant, Spotify or other logos. No gradient, shadow, texture, mockup, frame, watermark or presentation sheet. Deliver one clean original flat icon on transparency.
trademark_review: No trademark clearance search or legal review performed.
